edit.statement: Every tribune of the plebs in the Roman Republic took office on 10 December.
edit.subject: A tribune of the plebs in the Roman Republic
edit.scope: Tribunes of the plebs of the Roman Republic; their election date (in July in Cicero's time) is not covered.
